name: CIDP
author: Your Name or Organization
remarks: Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP) module
Based on 2021 EAN/PNS diagnostic guidelines
Models onset, diagnosis, treatment, and progression of CIDP and variants
2026-08 remediation (audit: 'the next HOHF' -- decades-long encounter lock
plus a 100x incidence typo):
- Annual incidence 0.00002 (2/100,000/yr), gated to ages 30+ (peak onset
40-60). The pre-fix module rolled 0.002 (100x too high) exactly once at
birth instead of annually from age 30. Broers et al., 'Incidence and
Prevalence of Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyradiculoneuropathy:
A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis', Neuroepidemiology 2019;52(3-4):
161-172 -- pooled incidence 0.33/100,000 person-years, pooled prevalence
2.81/100,000, with wide heterogeneity (0.67-10.3/100,000) across included
studies by diagnostic criteria. 2/100,000/yr sits at the upper end of that
range, consistent with this module's original 'using 2 per 100,000'
working value, chosen so CIDP cases remain observable in a synthetic
population.
- Every Encounter now closes (EncounterEnd) before any Delay of a day or
more, per visit. The pre-fix module opened CIDP_Diagnostic_Encounter,
Adjust_Treatment, and Regular_Monitoring and never closed any of them,
holding the person's single encounter-reservation lock for the rest of
their life once diagnosed.
- Monitoring loop restructured to Delay(~3mo) -> Encounter (open) ->
assess -> EncounterEnd -> loop, matching a standard CIDP maintenance
follow-up interval (EAN/PNS 2021 guidelines recommend reassessment
roughly every 3 months on stable maintenance therapy).
- The old 1%/cycle exit (0.89 loop / 0.10 complication / 0.01 Terminal,
which held the lock a median ~24 years before this fix) is replaced by
three real per-quarter outcomes: continue 94%, remission 5%, death
(other/unspecified cause) 1%. Compounded annually: ~78% remain in active
monitoring, ~18.5% enter remission, ~3.9% die of any cause per year.
Remission rate is consistent with published 1-year remission figures
(28-38% at 52 weeks in IVIG/IVMP vs IVIG/placebo trials; ~36% in remission
at 1 year in prospective cohorts) -- see PMC8782785 and related IVIG
cessation-trial literature. The ~3.9%/yr all-cause mortality figure is in
the range of pooled CIDP case-fatality estimates (~3.3-3.5%; 'Outcome in
chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy: A systematic review
and meta-analysis', Muscle Nerve), reflecting this population's excess
comorbidity burden (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, infection) rather
than a CIDP-specific cause -- the Death state below carries no cause-of-
death attribution.
- Loop-resident ConditionOnset/MedicationOrder states are now guarded
against duplicate stacking: Disease_Complications only fires once per
person (attribute-guarded), and oral maintenance azathioprine is
reachable at most once per person by construction (chronic: true, no
re-order path).
- IVIG_Therapy is now administration: true (clinician-administered
infusion, single administration row per firing, RxNorm 42386 already
maps to HCPCS J1599 in rxnorm_hcpcs_map.json -- no new export row
needed). Second_Line_Treatment (azathioprine) moved from the bare
ingredient RxCUI 1256 to the prescribable SCD RxCUI 197388 (Azathioprine
50 MG Oral Tablet), added to medication_code_map.json.
CIDP incidence is negligible before age 30 and peaks 40-60 (Broers 2019).
Nobody rolls the annual incidence check before 30.
Annual incidence roll, 2/100,000/yr (was a one-time 0.002 = 100x too
high, rolled once at birth instead of annually from age 30).
Pre-fix module ordered azathioprine on this branch with no open
encounter at all -- it silently attached to whatever encounter (or
synthetic wellness visit) happened to be current. Gets its own visit,
same as the Adjust_Treatment arm.
Quarterly monitoring-loop pass (~3 months), matching EAN/PNS 2021
guideline follow-up interval for stable CIDP on maintenance therapy.
Was GAUSSIAN mean=18 sd=6 weeks (~4.2mo); shortened to a true quarterly
cadence to match the per-pass outcome rates on Long_Term_Outcome.
Real per-quarter outcomes replacing the old 1%/cycle exit (0.89 loop /
0.10 complication / 0.01 Terminal, which held the encounter lock a
median ~24 years). See module remarks for sourcing.
Stacking guard: Disease_Complications is a ConditionOnset inside this
re-enterable loop, so it must fire at most once per person. Skips
straight back to Continue_Care once cidp_complication_onset is set.

codes.display: Brachial variant of chronic immune demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (disorder)

remarks: Remission exits the quarterly monitoring loop into a lower-intensity
annual surveillance loop rather than dead-ending at Terminal.
Death from other/unspecified causes during a monitoring interval --
deliberately carries no codes/condition_onset/referenced_by_attribute
so it is not coded as a CIDP-caused death (State.java Death.process:
reason stays null when none of the three cause-of-death fields are
set). Represents this population's excess comorbidity-driven
mortality (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, infection), not CIDP
itself.
